'''Leektar''' was an [[Ewok]] elder of the [[Bright Tree tribe]] who lived in [[Bright Tree Village]] on the [[planet]] [[Endor]]. After the Ewoks of the [[Bright Tree tribe]] captured a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebels]] and brought them back to the village, Leektar stood and watch in the village center as the [[prisoner]]s were prepared to be served in a banquet in honor of the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], who the Ewoks had mistaken for the [[deity]] known as the [[Golden One]].

After the prisoner [[Luke Skywalker]] [[Telekinesis|lifted]] C-3PO into the air using [[the Force]], the Ewoks released the rebels and ultimately agreed to [[Battle of Endor|fight]] alongside the rebels against the [[Galactic Empire]] on Endor. After the newly formed alliance triumphed over the Empire, Leektar joined the celebration that were held in Bright Tree Village.

==Biography==
Leektar<ref name="Absolutely Everything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> was an [[Ewok]] that lived in<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Bright Tree Village]] on the [[forest]] [[moon]] [[Endor]] as an elder<ref name="Absolutely Everything" /> of the [[Bright Tree tribe]].<ref name="CEUE">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VI}} to [[4 ABY]].</ref> the [[human]] [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] was brought to the village as a guest after traveling to the moon to [[Battle of Endor|fight]] the [[Galactic Empire]] there. Several of Organa's allies were later captured by<ref name="ROTJ" /> a [[scout]]ing party from the village led by the Ewok [[Teebo]]<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> and brought back to the village's center bound to wooden poles. Leektar was stood with [[Chief]] [[Chirpa]] by the entryway to one of the huts surrounding the village center when Organa emerged to see the new arrivals, who were being prepared to be cooked for a feast in the honor of [[C-3PO]], another ally of the princess who the Ewoks had mistaken for the [[deity]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> known as the [[Golden One]].<ref name="Vader">[[Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle 4|''Star Wars Adventures: Tales from Vader's Castle'' 4]]</ref>

At the behest of the [[prisoner]] [[Luke Skywalker]], C-3PO tried to convince the Ewoks to spare his friends and drew Leektar and other Ewoks attention when he announced that if they did not stop, he would become angry and use his magic. The Ewoks then continued as planned until Skywalker, a [[Force-sensitive]] [[Jedi]], used [[the Force]] to [[Telekinesis|lift]] C-3PO and his throne into the air. As the Ewoks rushed around in panic, Logray quickly ordered that the prisoners be released. That night, Leektar stood behind Chirpa's throne in the chief's hut while C-3PO shared stories with the Ewoks about he and his companions [[Galactic Civil War|fight]] against the Empire. After hearing the stories, Chirpa announced that the rebels were to be accepted into the tribe and that the Ewoks would aid them in destroying the Empire's [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] on Endor.<ref name="ROTJ" />

The next [[Standard day|day]], the Ewoks and the rebels attacked the Empire and successfully destroyed it, allowing an [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance fleet]] above to destroy the Empire's [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|Death Star II]] [[superweapon]]. That night, the rebels and Ewoks celebrated their victory in the village, with Leektar playing a pair of [[drum]]s next to Teebo during the celebration.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Leektar had [[Color|black]] [[Hair|fur]] and dark red [[eye]]s.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
Leektar wore a brown [[belt]] and a brown [[Clothing|hood]]<ref name="ROTJ" /> adorned with the [[Bone|skull]] of a horned forest beast.<ref name="Absolutely Everything" /> During the celebration the elder used a pair of drum sticks.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Leektar's name is pretty simple and straightforward- in Super Return of the Jedi for SNES, one of Wicket's favorite sound bites was "Yee-cha!" This is stuck in my head as the definitive Ewok sound. (Right next to "Goompa, Wicket" from those old cartoons.) So I took Yee-cha and played around with letters, striving for a phonetically similar sound.|Andrew Gilbertson|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|arfmaul|6|Leektar's Story: Everything you didn't need to know!}}</ref>}}
[[File:Malcolm_Dixon.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Malcolm Dixon portrayed Leektar]]
Leektar was portrayed by [[Malcolm Dixon]]<ref name="TMOROTJ">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The Ewok village scenes were filmed between [[January 18]] and [[February 2]], [[1982]] on Stage 3 at [[Elstree Studios]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Leektar was first identified in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''.<ref name="Absolutely Everything" />

The [[Leektar/Legends|character's]] name was first established in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created by [[Andrew Gilbertson]] for a databank entry that Gilbertson wrote with [[Arthur Papadam]] for the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature "[[What's The Story?]],"<ref name="blog">{{Blog|arfmaul|6|Leektar's Story: Everything you didn't need to know!}}</ref> which was published on [[November 18]], [[2005]].<ref name="Round3">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20051118.html|text=What's the Story, Round 3}}</ref> Gilbertson created the name by playing around with the letters of the exclamation "Yee-cha,"<ref name="blog" /> as used by the Ewok character [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] in the [[1994]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]'',<ref name="Super">''[[Super Star Wars: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> to find something phonetically similar, as the author considered the exclamation a definitive Ewok sound.<ref name="blog" />
